archetypes.name: ci-split-contract
archetypes.rationale: Workflow and replay surfaces must agree after the lint split.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the GitHub Actions split and Makefile target wiring together. Confirm python-lint no longer needs Node, python-pyright installs Node, and local make py-lint still runs all Python lint checks in order. Pay close attention to job names that branch protection and failed-job replay consume. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: replay-mapping
archetypes.rationale: CI failed-job classification and local replay are easy to drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit CI_FIXABLE_JOBS, ci-failed-jobs.sh, and ci_monitor.py for consistent python-pyright handling. Verify tests cover the new make py-typecheck replay path and that python-lint replay no longer runs pyright. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
